# Installers

Debug builds, signed with the Android debug key (fine for your own devices, not for the Play Store).

| File | Install on |
|---|---|
| `GolfCaddie-phone.apk` | Android phone (Android 8.0+) |
| `GolfCaddie-watch.apk` | Wear OS watch (Wear OS 3+), paired with the phone |

On the phone, open the APK and allow installing from that source when Android asks. Play Protect may
warn about an unknown developer; that's expected for a build that isn't from the Play Store.
